title: A/B state completion, click-safe bypass, crossfade switching
description:
Complete StateManager A/B comparison: two full configurations, instant switch with click-safe crossfade, copy A→B, and click-free latency-correct bypass hooks (CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §22.1, §22.2).

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp from phase A (existing A/B slots skeleton)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §22 Gain Matching and Comparison
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for bypass / A-B selector IDs if present
- Source/PluginProcessor.h for how APVTS state is get/setStateInformation listed (read-only; do not edit processor here)

Extend Source/StateManager.h/.cpp only:
- Two complete configuration slots A and B (full parameter ValueTree / APVTS snapshot plus any profile/tuning indices already owned by StateManager)
- activeSlot getter/setter; switchActiveSlot(A|B) prepares a short click-safe crossfade request (fade length constant, e.g. 3–10 ms worth of samples at current SR stored as pending envelope metadata — ChugGateAudioProcessor will consume it later in j.4)
- copyAtoB() / copyBtoA() / copyActiveToOther()
- compare-friendly accessors so GUI can show which slot is live without audio-thread allocations
- Bypass policy helpers: click-free, latency-correct, state-preserving, automation-safe notes/APIs (e.g. setBypassPending, isBypassActive) that do not glitch by hard-muting mid-block in the StateManager itself
- Persist both A and B slots plus active index in XML/ValueTree with existing schema_version field

Do not modify PluginProcessor, PluginEditor, Profiles, presets, or CMakeLists in this task — j.4 wires crossfade into processBlock.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/StateManager.h and Source/StateManager.cpp define dual A/B configuration slots with active-slot selection
StateManager provides copy A→B (and/or copy active→other) APIs
StateManager exposes click-safe crossfade switch request metadata for the processor to apply later
StateManager persists both A and B slots and active index with schema_version
StateManager provides bypass helper APIs documented as click-free, latency-correct, and state-preserving
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: expose crossfade remaining samples as atomic/int for audio thread
keep fade length as a named constant
forbidden: implement processBlock audio crossfade inside StateManager
rewrite entire state schema to a non-versioned format
